clips.creator: caitlinjesson
clips.caption: CONTRAMAR TUNA TOSTADAS ✨ iykyk… there are a lot of things I love about Mexico City but if I’m being honest these tostadas live rent free in my mind and they just might be my biggest motivator to go back time after time. The combo of the crunchy tortilla spread with chipotle mayo and topped with tuna, avo and crispy leeks is truly my own personal version of heaven. Save and follow @caitlinjesson for easy gluten free and dairy free recipes. 6 oz sushi grade tuna, thinly sliced 8 tortillas Olive oil Salt, to taste 1 leek, white part thinly sliced 2 cups avocado oil for frying ½ cup gluten free ponzu sauce 1 avocado, thinly sliced Fresh cilantro, for garnish For chipotle sauce: 1 large chipotle pepper in adobo sauce ¼ cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp lime juice Pinch of salt Preheat oven to 400°F. Drizzle tortillas with olive oil and sprinkle with salt then add to a baking sheet. Bake on convection setting on the first side for 6 minutes then flip and cook an additional 6 minutes longer on the second side until golden and crispy. Allow tortillas to cool before making tostadas. Heat avocado oil in a large frying pan and add leeks. Fry until golden brown and crispy, about 1-3 minutes, then remove from oil and season immediately with salt. To make chipotle mayo, combine ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Pour ponzu over tuna and allow fish to marinade for five minutes before building tostadas. Start by smearing chipotle mayo on tostada then add tuna, avocado slices and crispy leeks. Garnish with fresh cilantro. #food #foodie #glutenfree #dairyfree #cooking #healthyfood #recipe #healthyeating #healthyrecipes #easydinner #fish #seafood #fypシ゚viral #fypage
